summary.text: Ronda Boller is the Republican candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 52, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She defeated Bill Fortner in the Republican primary on August 18, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ronda Boller previously ran for Wyoming House of Representatives District 52 and lost the Republican primary to Reuben Tarver on August 16, 2022.
